title: Jesus Blesses the Children
description: People brought little children to Jesus so that he might touch them, but the disciples rebuked them. Jesus became indignant and said: "Let the little children come to me; do not stop them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these." He took them in his arms and blessed them.

versions.title: Jesus Blesses the Children
versions.description: Jesus welcomed the children and blessed them: 'Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.'
